Instruments

Only instruments that are on and have at least one clip can come up in the game. Clips are found automatically in four-corners/audio/ when they are named like oboe-1.mp3, oboe-2.mp3 and so on.

Clip maker

Load a recording from your computer, drag the red handles to pick 10-15 seconds and save it as an MP3 named for the game. Then upload the MP3 to four-corners/audio/ in your repo. Everything happens on this computer; nothing is uploaded.
